creature.description: creature the victim turns into. Defaults to the creature of the attacker

transmuteBy.description: 'health' keeps the total health of the victim, 'count' keeps its creature count

transmutation.description:
{Transmutation}
Has a ${val}% chance to transform the attacked unit into another type.

summonGuardians.description:
{Summon Guardians}
At the start of battle, summons ${creature} (${val}%).

level.description: mastery level the effects are applied at

massive.description: true to affect every allied unit instead of only the bearer

duration.description: how many turns the effects last. Defaults to 50, long enough to accumulate rather than expire between rounds

lifeDrain.description:
{Life Drain}
Restores health equal to ${val}% of damage dealt.

fireShield.description:
{Fire Shield}
Reflects ${val}% of melee damage back to the attacker.

spell.description: spell cast to kill them, deciding the animation, the immunities and the wording of the combat log. Defaults to death stare

deathStare.description:
{Death Stare}
Has a ${val}% chance to instantly kill one living creature.

killBy.description: 'percentage' kills a share of the victim's stack, 'count' kills a fixed number

amount.description: the share, or the number of creatures, depending on killBy

destruction.description:
{Destruction}
Has a ${val}% chance to kill additional creatures after attacking.

permanent.description: true to keep the gained creatures after the battle

soulSteal.description:
{Soul Steal}
Gains ${val} new creatures for each enemy killed.
